sources.authority: Local planning authorities / Historic England / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 11,050 conservation areas from 158 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22. It explicitly warns that coverage is incomplete and duplicate areas remain to be reconciled.
sources.quality_effect: A conservation-area intersection is material heritage context, but incomplete coverage, duplicates and mixed origin require authoritative local-document confirmation before parcel scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data conservation area document dataset
sources.authority: Local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 13,966 conservation-area documents from 86 providers; the collector last ran and new data was last found on 2026-07-21. The page warns that coverage may be incomplete.
sources.quality_effect: Documents can supply authoritative designation and management context, but document presence does not establish the exact polygon relation or current applicability by itself.

sources.authority: Participating local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 3,167 Article 4 directions from 101 providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2026-07-21. The service states that data comes from a small group used to develop the specification.
sources.quality_effect: A direction can remove permitted-development rights, but national completeness and mixed-origin limits require current order documents and linked area geometry before parcel use.

sources.source: Planning Data article 4 direction area dataset
sources.authority: Participating local planning authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 7,133 Article 4 direction areas from 110 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22, with an explicit incomplete-coverage warning and mixed origin.
sources.quality_effect: The geometry can identify where permitted-development rights are altered, but the linked direction, active dates and withdrawn rights must be verified before scoring.

sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 190 green-belt records from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2026-05-10. It states that annual returns form a snapshot and may omit later boundary changes.
sources.quality_effect: Green-belt geometry is strong policy context, but annual snapshot timing and mixed origin prevent assuming the boundary is current without local-plan readback.

sources.source: Planning Data flood risk zone dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 780,636 flood-risk zones from one authoritative provider; the collector last ran on 2023-11-01 and new data was last found on 2023-08-24. It states that zones indicate probability and do not predict definite flooding or severity.
sources.quality_effect: The polygons are authoritative screening evidence, but stale platform dates and probabilistic meaning require current Environment Agency confirmation and site-specific assessment.

sources.source: Planning Data flood risk level dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official category dataset contains three authoritative levels, references 1, 2 and 3; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2024-01-16.
sources.quality_effect: The category defines the level vocabulary only; it is not site geometry, flood depth, severity or an independently valid parcel measurement.

sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 1,047 current, emerging or historical local plans from 63 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22. The page states that the records were created by MHCLG and are intended to be replaced by authoritative-source data.
sources.quality_effect: Plan metadata can identify housing requirements and plan status, but current authority documents and process status must be read before investment or parcel conclusions.

sources.source: Planning Data local plan boundary dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 364 local-plan boundaries from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2026-03-18. Origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
sources.quality_effect: The boundary can route a site to the relevant plan, but it is not a site allocation, title parcel or proof that any policy positively supports development.

sources.source: Planning Data local planning authority dataset
sources.authority: Office for National Statistics / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official page reports 337 local-planning-authority boundaries from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2026-07-18, with mixed origin.
sources.quality_effect: The boundary identifies the responsible planning authority and supports routing, but it is administrative context rather than positive or negative parcel evidence.

sources.verified_fact: The official design page classifies protected views at Backlog stage; expected record count and update frequency are unknown and no technical specification is available.
sources.quality_effect: Protected views may be a material landscape constraint, but the current design-stage record cannot provide operational national geometry or parcel scoring.
